name: Reservation Value Inoculation
scenario: Enterprise procurement officer pressing an implementation vendor to state their absolute bottom-line pricing during an RFP defense.
script: "Our pricing schedule is directly indexed to the uptime requirements, liability coverage levels, and dedicated engineering allocations outlined in your RFP scope. We do not operate on arbitrary floor margins; we operate on rigorous cost-to-deliver parameters."
defense: Before discussing margin, ask which service-level provisions they would eliminate in exchange for fee reductions.
originFull: Anchoring Bias and Information Leakage vulnerabilities demonstrate that revealing an internal walk-away point collapses a negotiator's aspirational ceiling down to their reservation floor.
defenseFull: If a procurement team refuses to proceed without an immediate declaration of bottom-line pricing: "Before we can evaluate margin flexibility, we require your explicit operational priorities. Which specific service-level provisions are you prepared to eliminate in exchange for fee reductions?"
